notes.title: First Day Patch
notes.notes:
Hi! 
Friends, apparently the first level was too easy for many people, so we decided to rework it. About 30 cats have been re-hidden to new, less obvious places. Now the first level is more harmonious, the cats are evenly distributed throughout the level, and finding them will be a bit more challenging. 
Have a good game!
